description: This file is a shell script (bash/sh) used for firmware update management in a device. It handles tasks such as fetching firmware details, initiating firmware downloads via direct or Codebig methods, checking update criteria, scheduling reboots, and other maintenance operations related to firmware upgrades.

methods.name: getCurrentFw
methods.description: Retrieves the current firmware version from version files.

methods.name: checkFirmwareUpgCriteria
methods.description: Compares current firmware version with the target version to decide if upgrade is needed.

methods.name: isInStateRed
methods.description: Checks if the device is in a red recovery state.

methods.name: checkAndEnterStateRed
methods.description: Checks and transitions device into a recovery state if needed.

methods.name: get_Codebigconfig
methods.description: Configures Codebig connection settings based on feature availability and policies.

methods.name: useDirectRequest
methods.description: Performs firmware fetch requests via direct method.

methods.name: useCodebigRequest
methods.description: Performs firmware fetch requests via Codebig method.
